title: Discovery
description: We start by understanding your business, your users, and the problem you're solving. Every great product begins with deep listening.
details: Stakeholder interviews, user research, competitive analysis, requirements documentation.

title: Planning
description: We define the architecture, timelines, and milestones. You'll know exactly what we're building, when, and why.
details: Technical architecture, project roadmap, sprint planning, resource allocation.

title: Design
description: We design interfaces that are intuitive, accessible, and beautiful. Every pixel serves a purpose.
details: Wireframes, UI/UX design, prototyping, design system creation, user testing.

title: Development
description: Our engineers build your product using modern, proven technologies. We write clean, maintainable code that scales.
details: Frontend development, backend development, API integration, database design.

title: Testing
description: We test rigorously before anything goes live. Quality isn't an afterthought — it's built into every step.
details: Unit testing, integration testing, performance testing, security auditing, UAT.

title: Deployment
description: We deploy to production with zero downtime and full monitoring. Your product is live and ready for users.
details: Cloud deployment, CI/CD setup, monitoring configuration, performance optimization.

title: Support
description: We don't disappear after launch. We provide ongoing maintenance, updates, and enhancements to keep your product running at its best.
details: Bug fixes, security patches, feature enhancements, performance monitoring, 24/7 support.
